subject: M4 analysis — July vulcan reservation
body: Ines — compute forecast for the M4 analysis so the July crunch doesn't surprise anyone. Activation extraction on the production multilingual model is the heavy step: full encoder/decoder activations per language pair, per layer, per checkpoint, for the SVCCA grid. We hold the vulcan-h100 reservation for the week of 2026-07-06 — 256 GPUs — and the full extraction plus SVCCA grid is planned against that week. Extraction fills roughly the first three days; the SVCCA computation itself is CPU-heavy, so days 4-5 are mostly staging results into Corpus while the GPUs run the finetuning probes. Asks: confirm the reservation shows on your side, and confirm the post-maintenance health checks from the 06-22 to 06-24 vulcan window won't spill into July. Dev-scale extraction runs on titan meanwhile. — Alina
